name: Dental lab case tracker
summary: The office coordinator keeps one tracker of every case at an outside dental lab: when it went, the lab's due date against the patient's seating, which cases are overdue or due back too late, each remake with its stated reason, and each lab's on-time record for the quarter. A person calls every lab.

sources.title: The front-office form of the work: a spreadsheet export with stated column headers and a stop on any mismatch, unread columns named and never repeated, check-in days held back before each seating, cases sorted into fixed lists, remake reasons copied as written and never judged, a quarterly record per lab from the office's own dates with no targets or ranking, and nothing contacted, booked or changed.

sources.contribution: Setting the date a lab expects to return a case against the patient's booked visit; having the work back early enough to be looked over before that visit; recording each remake with why it was needed; a quarterly review of each lab that includes whether cases came back by the promised date. Its order, shade, material, inspection and digital-file content is not used.
